How oenodPay Lend works and the risks of lending.

Lending money carries risk. Borrowers can pay late or not at all, and you can lose some or all of the money you lend. Target returns are not guaranteed. Lend is not a deposit and is not covered by CDIC or any investor protection fund.

You choose an amount and a term. We split it across many small loans to checked oenodPay members. As borrowers repay, principal and interest come back to your balance monthly, minus a 1% yearly service fee.
Lend will be offered only where provincial securities rules allow it and to people who meet the eligibility rules for their province, which may include investment limits.
Your money is committed for the term you choose. You may be able to sell your loan parts to other lenders, but this isn't guaranteed.
What we tell you before you borrow.

Before you accept any loan we show the annual percentage rate (APR), every payment amount and date, any fees, and the total cost of borrowing, as federal and provincial cost-of-borrowing rules require.
You can repay early at any time without a penalty. In most provinces you can cancel a loan within 2 business days of signing. Every rate stays under Canada's criminal interest rate limit.
We report loan payments to credit bureaus. On-time payments can help your score; missed payments can hurt it.
